name: Sunscorched Shells
summary: In Darnassus, Mathiel seeks wyvern eggshells to strengthen a new mailcrafting technique. The armorer works with the dwarven smith Furen Longbeard and sends warriors to gather shells from Highperch in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Cross-Faction Crafting Alliance
sections.body: Mathiel works from the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus and looks beyond night elven methods. He corresponds with Furen Longbeard, a skilled dwarven armorer in Stormwind, and draws on Furen's discoveries in metalwork and armor-smithing. Mathiel hopes to make mail reinforced with natural materials that can withstand great strain. To test the idea, he needs materials found nowhere near Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Perils of Highperch
sections.body: Mathiel's experiment calls for shells from Highperch, far south across the sea in the canyon gorges of Thousand Needles. Wyverns nest high above the salt flats and red stone mesas, beneath Kalimdor's blazing sun. Constant exposure to heat and altitude hardens their eggshells. Mathiel plans to grind the sun-baked fragments into a resilient lacquer and coat chainmail links, making armor that bends while enduring exceptional strain.

faq.answer: Mathiel is a night elf armorer on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. He works with dwarven methods and Furen Longbeard to develop advanced mail armor for proven warriors.

faq.q: Why does Mathiel need wyvern shells?
faq.answer: Highperch wyvern shells harden beneath the harsh sun of Thousand Needles. Mathiel plans to grind and render them into lacquer for mail links, strengthening the armor.
Highperch is a steep mesa in western Thousand Needles, near the Feralas border. Wyverns nest across its cliffs and plateau.

faq.q: How does Furen Longbeard relate to this quest?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorer in Stormwind. Mathiel respects him as a colleague and draws inspiration from his armor-crafting discoveries.

faq.q: Why is an elf in Darnassus asking for materials from Thousand Needles?
faq.answer: Mathiel needs a resilience found in wyvern eggs exposed to the dry heat of the southern canyon mesas. That heat cannot be recreated in Teldrassil's misty boughs.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the shells to Mathiel?
faq.answer: After Mathiel receives twenty sunscorched shells, he begins rendering the lacquer and forging a bespoke mail suit for you in return for your field efforts.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you can help Mathiel test a way to make resilient mail armor.
You can see an unusual smithing method at work: beast materials become a protective lacquer for metal chain links.
You can see night elf craftsmen in Darnassus exchanging techniques with dwarven armorers in Stormwind.
